rules.description: Applicant must be at least 16 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 16 years old to apply for Access to Work

rules.description: Applicant must have a disability, illness or health condition affecting their ability to work
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a physical or mental health condition or disability that means you need support to do your job or get to/from work

rules.description: Applicant must live and work in England, Scotland or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: This service is only available if you live and work in England, Scotland or Wales. There's a different system in Northern Ireland.

rules.description: Applicant must be in paid work or starting/returning within 12 weeks
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be in paid work, or be about to start or return to paid work in the next 12 weeks

rules.description: Applicant must not be a civil servant
rules.reason_if_failed: If you're a civil servant, your employer will provide support instead of Access to Work. Contact your employer directly.

rules.description: If self-employed, annual turnover must be at least £6,500
rules.reason_if_failed: If you're self-employed, you must have an annual turnover of at least £6,500

rules.description: Applicant must work more than 1 hour per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You must work more than 1 hour a week to be eligible for Access to Work

rules.description: If receiving ESA, must work less than 16 hours per week
rules.reason_if_failed: If you're getting Employment and Support Allowance (ESA), you can only get Access to Work if you work less than 16 hours a week

edge_cases.action: Route to employer. Civil servants receive support directly from their employer, not through Access to Work.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has previously received Access to Work mental health support
edge_cases.action: Reject mental health support application. Applicants can only claim Access to Work mental health support once.

edge_cases.description: Applicant lives in Channel Islands or Isle of Man
edge_cases.action: Reject application. Access to Work is not available if you live in the Channel Islands or the Isle of Man.

edge_cases.description: Support needed may be a reasonable adjustment (employer's legal obligation)
edge_cases.action: Advise applicant and employer. Access to Work will not pay for reasonable adjustments. These are changes your employer must legally make.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has symptoms but no formal diagnosis
edge_cases.action: Proceed with application. You do not need to be diagnosed with a condition to apply for Access to Work.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is doing voluntary work, not paid employment
edge_cases.action: Reject application. You cannot get Access to Work support for voluntary work.

edge_cases.description: Applicant needs communication support for job interview only
edge_cases.action: Route to separate application process for communication support at job interviews.
